title: Fabry Perot Open Resonators (FPOR) and Microwave Components
agency: COMMERCE, DEPARTMENT OF.NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STANDARDS AND TECHNOLOGY.DEPT OF COMMERCE NIST
description_text: 4/7/26: Amendment 03 is issued to revise the Statement of Work and extend the response due date to Monday, April 13, 2026 at 10:00 am EDT. See revised Attachment 1 -SOW with highlighted changes. 3/26/26: Amendment 02 is issued to revise Solicitation QandA to add more detail to answers A1, A4, and change the answer to A2. See attached Solicitation QandA 3-26-26 with changes highlighted. 3/25/26: Amendment 01 is issued to extend the response due date by 48 hours to Friday, March 27, 2026 at 10:00am EDT, provide responses to solicitation questions, and revise the SOW accordinlgy. See attached Solicitation QandA and Revised Attachment 1 SOW with highlighted changes for full details. The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) has a requirement for Fabry Perot Open Resonators (FPOR) and microwave components at its Boulder, Maryland campus. Please see attached Solicitation# 1333ND26QNB030032 and related attachments 1 (Statement of Work) and 2 (Appricable Provisons and Clauses) for full details.
